item.title: Where MCP Would Fit in a Project Like Standflow
item.description: Model Context Protocol is not a replacement for a REST API. A short reflection on what it is, and where it would actually belong in a system I have already built.

item.title: Architecture of an LLM-Backed Rubric Assessor
item.description: How a small Express service turns a rubric and a student report into structured, schema-validated AI feedback: the data flow, the prompt contract, the error handling, and how it was tested without a real API call.
